m1-headroom-param.title: (a) thresholds_for takes an absolute-token reserve and can only TIGHTEN
m1-headroom-param.imperative: TDD. Write tests in tests/test_gauge_reader.py (every name matching 'headroom' or 'override') that fail against today's thresholds_for(model): a well-formed reserve lowers BOTH caps' fractions; a reserve larger than a cap clamps that fraction at 0.0; and a hostile sweep (negative, huge-negative, zero) can never return a fraction ABOVE the un-overridden pair, for every model in the table. Observe them RED, attest c1, then add headroom_tokens=0 to thresholds_for with the two clamps (reserve clamped non-negative; each cap clamped non-negative) and make them GREEN. Do NOT touch _PROFILES.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: new gauge_reader headroom tests written and observed failing against the old signature
thresholds_for(model, headroom_tokens=0) subtracts from both caps, clamps at 0, cannot loosen; gauge_reader suite green

constraints: tighten-only is structural, not merely untested

m2-resolver.title: (b) One gate-level resolver in the engine; missing/malformed/negative -> 0
m2-resolver.imperative: TDD. Write tests in tests/test_checklist_engine.py (names matching 'headroom' or 'override') for a single resolver reading tasks.<gate>.context_headroom_tokens ONLY. The malformed/negative test MUST carry, in the SAME test and through the SAME resolver, a well-formed override resolving to a DIFFERENT number -- a resolve-to-default-only test passes with the mechanism dead-coded. Observe RED, attest c1, then add the resolver and make GREEN. No checklist-config tier; no threshold arithmetic in the engine.
